result.title: FireDesmoke: Fire Smoke Removal via Real Smoke Transfer and Semantic Rectification
result.summary: Fire smoke removal must restore dense and medium smoke regions while preserving the clear (smoke-free) content. Existing methods either leave the smoke or alter the visible content, and generative models may hallucinate people or remove flames. Real fire smoke is spatially local: the degradation and its corruption of semantic features are both concentrated in the smoke regions. We propose FireDesmoke, built on this locality: Real Smoke Transfer calibrates smoke fields on real-fire recordings and transfers their spatial layout onto clean images to synthesize training pairs, and Semantic Rectification uses pixel features to rectify the tokens of a frozen foundation encoder where smoke corrupts them. With matched training budgets, replacing the transferred pairs with SmokeBench pairs lowers dense-smoke PSNR by 0.74 dB, and removing Semantic Rectification leaves clear regions 1.31 dB below the input. On what is, to the best of our knowledge, the first paired dataset of real fire smoke for image restoration, with 1,500 test frames from a held-out viewpoint, FireDesmoke improves dense- and medium-smoke PSNR by 3.73 and 2.63 dB while keeping clear regions at the input level (+0.41 dB); no other compared method gains at least 1 dB in dense smoke without lowering clear-region PSNR, and no hallucinated person is found in its outputs. It achieves state-of-the-art overall results on this benchmark and, trained on SmokeBench, the highest PSNR with the second-best SSIM and LPIPS.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 FireDesmoke 用于真实火灾烟雾去除：一方面把真实火场烟雾场迁移到清晰图像上合成训练对，另一方面用像素特征校正冻结基础编码器中被烟雾污染的 token，以在去除浓烟的同时保持清晰区域不变。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「退化在空间上局部集中、并按位置校正冻结编码器中被污染的 token」这一机制，可能为 LVR 中受损视觉证据的筛选与内部视觉特征的局部纠错提供借鉴，可供核查其能否迁移到 latent 状态的保真问题。
